item.text: {"search_note":"I searched for 2024 material on `Egypt`, `El-Dabaa`, `IAEA`, `nuclear security`, `safeguards`, `safety`, `accident prevention`, and `command and control`. I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a custody lapse, a safety incident, weakened procedural discipline, or a public decision by Sisi to relax nuclear safety controls. The main limitation is that available sources are mostly program speeches, institutional references, and IAEA publication listings, not an independent operational audit of custody or command-chain discipline. So the evidence base is positive but indirect, and the absence of incident-level reporting should be treated as a search gap, not proof of perfection.","evidence":[{"title":"President El-Sisi Pleased with Historic Moment of Pouring 1st Concrete into El-Dabaa Power Unit 4","publisher":"Presidency of the Republic of Egypt","date":"2024-01-23","url":"https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news2312024-1/","summary":"Sisi framed El-Dabaa as a “peaceful nuclear plant” and a national milestone.
